title: Release
description: One published release, recorded by the release pipeline after the artifacts exist and verified afterwards by everything that reads it. The record is the repository's evidence of what was published: the tag, the commit it was built from, and every artifact with its digest and size. The public release metadata the installer reads is a projection of these records; a release the pipeline did not record was not published.

version.description: The semantic version, without a leading v; equal to the version of the crate the artifacts were built from.

tag.description: The git tag that triggered the release; v followed by the version, and nothing else.

channel.description: stable is what an unpinned installation resolves to; prerelease is published, addressable by its exact tag, and never resolved by default.

commit.description: The commit the artifacts were built from.

published_at.description: When the release was published, UTC.

notes_url.description: The release notes a person reads.

yanked.description: True when the release must no longer be resolved: it stays addressable by its exact tag and stops being a candidate for the stable pointer. This is how a bad release is withdrawn without deleting artifacts anyone already has.

artifacts.description: One entry per built target, in the order the distribution model declares them.

target.description: The id of the target in the distribution model; every supported target must appear exactly once and nothing else may appear.

name.description: The artifact's file name, exactly as the naming function derives it.

url.description: Where the artifact is downloaded from.

sha256.description: The digest the installer verifies before it extracts anything.

size.description: The artifact's size in bytes, as published.
